item.title: Identity, Living Fearless book review
item.description:
![[livingfearless.jpg]]

One book that has made a difference in my life was The Cross and the Switchblade by David Wilkerson. It was amazing to see how the holy spirit guided Wilkerson in his life. His struggles as he learned…..
